## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] New UI strings go through i18n (no hard-coded text)
- [ ] Keyboard access, focus order and ARIA labels checked for new UI

- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated where relevant
- [ ] No fonts or assets added without an open license file
